versions.changelog: Soften description with 'soft, opt-in, advisory, never-blocking' framing to address ClawHub AI scanner verdict on v1.0.6
Rewrite description with moment-of-need triggers; add Quick Reference table for guard selection
Privacy-by-default: audit logging now opt-in via auditLogPath; no user content captured
Add skill-card.md for ClawHub card verification.

Initial release of rl-runtime-guard.

- Introduces pre-tool-call runtime guardrails for AI agents, catching 82.5% of common agent errors via soft prompt augmentation.
- Three guards included: complex task decomposition, retry loop prevention, and tool/path mismatch detection.
- Calibrated thresholds based on 12,000+ real agent interactions.
- Fully local, no network or external dependencies; logs decisions for audit.
- Supports easy configuration and enable/disable via JSON config or environment variable.
